name: Country Info
tagline: Facts about any country — flag, population, languages
description: Look up comprehensive information about any country: official name, capital, population, region, languages, currencies, flag emoji, area, and calling code. Uses the free RestCountries API — no API key required.

expert_defs.name: country_info_lookup
expert_defs.description: Returns facts about a country: official name, capital, population, region, languages, currencies, flag, and more. Uses restcountries.com. Param: query (country name or 2/3-letter code). Returns JSON with output_type json.
code: currs = [v.get('name', k) for k, v in c.get('currencies', {}).items()][:3]

result = {'name': c.get('name', {}).get('common', q), 'official_name': c.get('name', {}).get('official', ''), 'capital': (c.get('capital') or [''])[0], 'population': c.get('population', 0), 'area_km2': c.get('area', 0), 'region': c.get('region', ''), 'subregion': c.get('subregion', ''), 'languages': langs, 'currencies': currs, 'flag': c.get('flag', ''), 'calling_code': '+' + (c.get('idd', {}).get('root', '') + (c.get('idd', {}).get('suffixes') or [''])[0]).lstrip('+'), 'timezone': (c.get('timezones') or [''])[0]}

conceptTexts: Plugin: Country Info (id: country-info). Expert country_info_lookup returns facts about any country using restcountries.com (free). Param: query (country name or ISO code). Returns {output_type: 'json', data: {name, official_name, capital, population, area_km2, region, languages, currencies, flag, calling_code}}.
